youtube.title: Aankhein khol ke chheenk kyun nahi aati? 🤧 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Agar aap chheenkte waqt aankhein khuli rakhein, toh woh bahar nahi nikalti. Phir bhi lagbhag koi unhe khuli rakh hi nahi pata.

Chheenk ek reflex hai jo aapka brainstem khud chalata hai. Hawa ke dhakke ke saath yeh aapki palkon ki nasein bhi dabata hai, aur force aapki chest se aata hai, aankhon ke peeche se nahi.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
